observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Street performance outside a local tavern or shop, with a seated crowd watching on the side of the road.
observation.dancers: Mixed group of children and adults, featuring solo dancers and shifting groups.
observation.formation_and_space: Informal open space in the street, with dancers taking turns in the center while others watch from the perimeter.
observation.posture: Upper body upright or leaning forward slightly, knees bent with a low center of gravity.
observation.footwork: Energetic rapid stepping, hopping, and shuffling on the beat, with quick shifts of weight.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held loosely by the sides or moving with the rhythm, sometimes gesturing or clapping.
observation.hips_and_torso: Pronounced hip shaking and shaking of the fringed skirt.
observation.partnering: None, solo and group dancing without physical contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, low squats, drops to hands and feet, and fast turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional fringed skirts (xibelani), t-shirts, headbands, and colorful sneakers.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise footwork details are obscured by low camera resolution and fast movement.

signature_moments.what: Dancer drops down to hands and knees while rapidly shaking hips and skirt
Dancer hops rapidly on one spot with vigorous hip shaking and upright torso
Dancer drops low into a crouch and bounces rapidly on the beat
